2) Quote value: attachment-02 / attachment-03 price £135 general EOT + deep clean, £45 bedroom 2 carpet shampoo, £25 freezer defrost = £205 calculated; no total and no VAT status stated in either document.
3) Scope vs quote: event-017 instructed the provider to clean BOTH bedroom carpets; the quote prices bedroom 2 only (£45). Any bedroom 1 carpet charge is unquoted and must be checked against the invoice before it goes to the landlord.
4) Invoice outstanding: requested event-026 and chased event-030; provider replies (event-029, event-032, event-033) suggest an attachment was sent but no invoice is on the case. Outcome unknown — do not assume received.
5) SAFETY CHECK: check-out report (attachment-01) detector section records "Tested? No" and the detector photograph caption repeats that detectors were not tested; this specific line beats the report's boilerplate that alarms "were stated to have been checked and working". The property was released for a move-in on 30/11/2024 (event-025) with no record of a smoke/CO alarm test. Not a reported hazard, but an unverified pre-move-in safety check at a now-occupied property.
6) Data quality: event-011 refers to a quote for "Flat 27, 117 Lantern Quay, Kingshaven" on this Flat 10 job; both attached quotes name Flat 10. event-013 (landlord-addressed wording "Hi Palmer... do you wish to proceed") was sent to the provider; resent correctly to the landlord at event-015.
